facts.text: Serve the main when Georgia orders everything Chef Didier makes.
facts.why: At the hotel Georgia hears Chef Didier never repeats a menu, says she had better try them all tonight, and takes the lot ('Tout, baby').
Same scene: Georgia asks the waiter for all of Chef Didier's specials, so ordering everything on the menu is true to the film.

facts.text: Straight out of Georgia's scrapbook, finally on a real plate.
facts.why: The scrapbook holds her dream husband and her Possibilities. What she actually does is cook Emeril recipes for a neighbour while denying herself the food.
facts.fix: Georgia cooked it for the neighbour. Tonight she eats it.
